name: Crisp
gaps: Parcels are CrispParcels (SGRC_GIS / RVRC_ELA) (https://services1.arcgis.com/Ug5xGQbHsD8zuZzM/arcgis/rest/services/CrispParcels/FeatureServer/0). Published acreage is filtered to 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Pass 2 enrichment is from rural-oz-pass2 csv (tax REST, sale REST-partial, owner REST). GDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Pass 2 sale is partial (saleland1/saleimp1 component prices only (183/99 >0); sale_val=0; no date). Deed book text and component prices are not stored as a last-sale price or date.
Property-appraiser links are filled from the pass-2 template with each parcel id and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
